tour.say: Good evening. I am Count Cuspid. This castle sends every AI question to the cheapest helper that can answer it. Come, I will walk you in.
The iron gates open as we arrive, and the great door too. Four seconds from the road to the hall.
The Great Hall. The board shows the saved run of the real stack: 120 calls, 52% answered from the cache, 13,763 tokens kept off the big model.
The Observatory counts every call. The second time the same 60 questions came in, 57 were served from the cache with no model, and the ladder spent $0.00023.
The Crypt is the cache in Supabase. Asked again, the hit rate was 0.95. A lookup takes 122 ms. 0 of 50 graded cache answers were wrong.

The Ladder climbs one rung at a time: cache, then our own 30B, then the 763B. Per 1,000 coding calls the 763B costs $0.1576, GPT-5.5 costs $4.02. The bank of solved problems served 75 of 80 repeats, 0 wrong.
The Familiar is a small model for your phone. It is written, but no phone has run it yet. I will not pretend otherwise.
The Workshop shows how Kiro built this castle: 7 steering files, 7 specs, 6 hooks, 4 custom agents, 3 MCP tools and a Power. Hypothesis tried 43 property tests and found 4 real bugs. 4 are fixed.
The Tower holds the biggest models. We tried speculative decoding on Modal: EAGLE-3 in the same box ran 1.80x as fast, but a drafter on another box ran at only 0.23x. We show both.
The Manor is our own GPU. A 30B on an H200 kept busy costs $0.070 per 1,000 calls. On our own V100, tuned and kept busy, it costs $0.178; before tuning it cost $11.02.
The Guild is for companies: an OpenAI-style gateway, keys per tenant, metrics for Prometheus. Change one address and one key.
The Gate: four commands and it runs on your machine. The tests need no models and no keys.

And the bill. At 1 million coding calls a day, GPT-5.5 alone costs $120,600 a month. With the cache, the bank and our 30B first: $25,216, 79% less. Against the cheap 763B we do not save at that volume: the ladder costs $2,518 a month more. Every number here comes from a file. Good night.
